name: CF Token Manager
author: JWTPOC
shortDescription: A complete JWT token lifecycle manager for CFML/ColdBox: issue, verify, refresh and decode access & refresh tokens with Java crypto signing.
description: cf-token-manager extends a low-level JWT engine into a full authentication token lifecycle package. It exposes issue(), verify(), refresh() and decode() while internally handling header/payload construction, automatic expiry, access + refresh token generation and Java-based HMAC signing.
